Get started开始使用

  1. Open the task board and enter the workspace password shared with you privately by the team. The password is not listed in this guide.
  2. If a Your name field appears, enter your own name. It appears only when shared mode is configured.
  3. Choose a category or use search, status, owner and Organizer only filters. On a phone, swipe the category navigation horizontally.
  4. Click a task title to read its deadline, deliverables and completion guidance before making changes.
  1. 打开任务看板，输入团队私下提供的密码。本说明页不公布密码。
  2. 如果出现 Your name，填写自己的姓名；该字段只在配置了团队共享时出现。
  3. 选择分类，或按关键词、状态、负责人和 Organizer only 筛选。在手机上可横向滑动分类栏。
  4. 点击任务标题，先查看截止时间、交付内容与完成检查项，再进行修改。

Update a task如何修改任务

Inside a task, choose a Status, select an Owner, set an optional Internal target date, and add Notes. Click Save changes and wait for confirmation.

  • To do: not started. In progress: being worked on. Blocked: waiting for something. Done: the task’s deliverable is complete.
  • The checkbox immediately saves the task as Done. Unchecking it sets the task back to To do.
  • An internal target date does not change the organizer’s submission deadline.
  • Organizer labels identify organizer requirements. Completion guidance may also include internal suggestions.

Saving or uploading here does not email the organizer, submit your materials, or update Notion. Follow the submission instructions inside the relevant task.

打开任务后，设置 Status（状态）、Owner（负责人）、可选的 Internal target date（内部目标日期） 和 Notes（备注）。点击 Save changes，等待保存确认。

  • To do：未开始；In progress：进行中；Blocked：等待条件；Done：已完成该任务的交付。
  • 直接勾选复选框会立即保存为 Done；取消勾选会改回 To do。
  • 内部目标日期不会修改主办方规定的提交截止时间。
  • Organizer 标签表示主办方要求；完成检查项中也可能包含团队内部建议。

在这里保存或上传，不等于给主办方发邮件、正式提交材料或更新 Notion。正式提交请遵循对应任务里的说明。

Save & move progress保存、备份与转移进度

When the board says “Saved on this browser”

Changes belong to this browser and device. Other teammates cannot see them. Refreshing and unlocking in the same browser restores saved progress, but clearing site data, changing browser/device, or ending a private-browsing session can remove access to that copy.

  1. Click Export progress to download an encrypted JSON backup.
  2. On the other device, unlock the board, click Import, and select that JSON file.
  3. Import replaces that browser’s current progress after confirmation; it does not merge copies. Export the current copy first if you need it.

An older export may ask for the password used when it was created. Import is for progress JSON only; it is not an upload button for decks or images.

When shared mode is enabled

Wait for Saved to GitHub or another success confirmation. Use Refresh to load the latest team progress. The board also refreshes about once a minute while visible and no task is being edited. Earlier local progress is kept separately; Export earlier local progress backs it up without replacing shared records.

显示“Saved on this browser”时

修改只属于当前浏览器和设备，其他成员看不到。在同一浏览器刷新并重新解锁，可以恢复已保存的进度；清除网站数据、更换浏览器或设备、结束无痕会话，都可能让你无法继续读取这份本地记录。

  1. 点击 Export progress，下载加密的 JSON 进度备份。
  2. 在另一设备解锁网站，点击 Import，选择该 JSON 文件。
  3. 确认导入后，会替换该浏览器当前的进度，而不是合并两份记录。如需保留当前内容，请先导出备份。

较早版本的备份可能需要输入生成它时使用的密码。Import 只导入进度 JSON，不是上传 PPT 或图片的入口。

开启团队共享后

等待出现 Saved to GitHub 等成功提示。点击 Refresh 获取团队最新进度；页面可见且未编辑任务时，也会约每分钟刷新。此前的本地记录单独保留，可以用 Export earlier local progress 备份，不会自动覆盖团队数据。

Files & document links上传文件与分享在线文档

Once team sharing is enabled, open a task and find Files & links:

  • Upload file: choose a deck, image, PDF or other file up to 10 MiB. Wait for “Uploaded and attached to the shared task.” The attachment is saved immediately, separately from other unsaved task fields.
  • Download: click an attachment’s filename. Decks download as files; an online PowerPoint link is better if you want teammates to open it in the browser.
  • Add link: enter a title and a full HTTPS URL, click Add link, then Save changes. Links are not saved until the task is saved.
  • Larger files: use a PowerPoint/OneDrive, Google Drive, Canva or other online link. Set viewing permissions so teammates can open it. The 10 MiB limit is this website’s upload limit.

Without shared mode, these controls are hidden. A URL pasted into Notes is only part of your local note; it does not share the document with the team.

团队共享开启后，打开任务，在 Files & links 中操作：

  • Upload file：选择 deck、图片、PDF 等文件，单个不超过 10 MiB。等待“Uploaded and attached to the shared task”提示；附件会立即关联到团队任务，与其他尚未保存的任务字段分开保存。
  • 下载：点击附件文件名。Deck 会作为文件下载；希望大家直接在浏览器里查看 PowerPoint 时，优先使用在线文档链接。
  • Add link：填写标题和完整 HTTPS 链接，点击 Add link，再点击 Save changes；只有保存任务后，链接才会保存。
  • 大文件：改用 PowerPoint／OneDrive、Google Drive、Canva 等链接，并设置好成员的查看权限。10 MiB 是本网站的单文件上传上限。

未开启共享时，这些控件不会显示。把链接粘贴到 Notes，只会存进自己的本地备注，并不会把文档分享给团队。

Team activity & editing conflicts团队记录与同时编辑

When sharing is enabled, Team activity shows up to 200 recent updates and 200 sign-ins, including the supplied name and time. The shared password does not verify a person’s identity; names are self-reported. Browser-local mode does not record a shared visitor or completion history.

If someone changes a task while you are editing it, saving shows a conflict and keeps your draft open. Copy your unsaved text before using Reload shared task, because reloading discards the form’s unsaved fields after confirmation. Reapply your changes to the latest version and save again.

共享开启后，Team activity 展示最近最多 200 条更新与 200 条登录记录，包括填写的姓名和时间。共享密码不能验证真实个人身份，姓名由使用者自行填写。本地模式没有团队统一的访问或完成记录。

如果你编辑时别人也修改了同一任务，保存会提示冲突，并保留当前草稿。先复制未保存的内容，再点击 Reload shared task；确认重新加载后，表单中未保存的字段会被丢弃。基于最新版本重新修改并保存。

Common questions常见问题

Why can’t someone else see my checkmarks?

Check the mode at the top of this page. In browser-local mode, each person has a separate copy. Export/import transfers a copy manually; it is not live team synchronization.

Why is there no upload button?

Files & links is available only when shared mode is configured and you have signed in. In browser-local mode, Import is only for encrypted progress backups.

What if a save or upload fails?

Do not assume it succeeded. Keep the form open and copy your unsaved notes. In shared mode, refresh and check the current task and attachment list before retrying an upload; a network error can occur after a save reached the server.

Can I leave the board safely?

Finish saving first, then use Lock or Lock workspace. You will need the workspace password again. Locking keeps saved progress; it does not delete it. Export important local progress before clearing browser data.

为什么别人看不到我的勾选？

先看本页顶部的模式。本地模式下，每个人持有各自的一份进度。导入导出可以人工转移副本，但不是团队实时同步。

为什么没有上传按钮？

只有配置了共享模式并成功登录后，才会显示 Files & links。本地模式中的 Import 只用于导入加密进度备份。

保存或上传失败怎么办？

不要当作已成功。保持表单打开，并复制未保存的备注。共享模式下，重新刷新并核对任务和附件列表，再决定是否重试上传；网络报错也可能发生在服务器已收到保存之后。

用完如何退出？

先等保存完成，再点击 Lock 或 Lock workspace，下次进入需要重新输入密码。锁定不会删除已保存的进度。清除浏览器数据前，先导出重要的本地记录。
